<font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-04</b></font> Periodic access review" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="20" y="46" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="reg2" value="<font color="#8f1d16"><b>AM-07</b></font> <b>Accounts are taken over because sign-in is weak or can be bypassed</b><br><font color="#4a5869">How it could happen here:</font> The Identity App issues a token for the wrong person.<br><font color="#4a5869">Controls:</font> <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-03</b></font> Restricted admin and signing-key access &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-08</b></font> Entra-only sign-in &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>CM-01</b></font> Reviewed changes" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="20" y="118" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="reg3" value="<font color="#8f1d16"><b>AM-07</b></font> <b>Accounts are taken over because sign-in is weak or can be bypassed</b><br><font color="#4a5869">How it could happen here:</font> Production is reached without MFA through the command line.<br><font color="#4a5869">Controls:</font> <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>Proposed</b></font> MFA on every sign-in" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="20" y="190" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="reg4" value="<font color="#8f1d16"><b>AM-05</b></font> <b>Service accounts are misused or have no owner</b><br><font color="#4a5869">How it could happen here:</font> Service accounts outside Active Directory (Cognito) have no owner and are never reviewed.<br><font color="#4a5869">Controls:</font> <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-06</b></font> Owned, restricted service accounts &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-04</b></font> Periodic access review" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="670" y="46" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="reg5" value="<font color="#8f1d16"><b>CM-08</b></font> <b>Direct changes to production databases go undetected</b><br><font color="#4a5869">How it could happen here:</font> The authorization table is changed outside the approved process.<br><font color="#4a5869">Controls:</font> <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>CM-02</b></font> Restricted write access &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>CM-09</b></font> Reviewed database changes &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>LA-01</b></font> Edits logged" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="670" y="118" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="reg6" value="<font color="#8f1d16"><b>AM-02</b></font> <b>Privileged access, or the credentials and code that grant it, is misused or excessive</b><br><font color="#4a5869">How it could happen here:</font> IAM user keys in Parameter Store, or the Lambda code, are misused to assume any role.<br><font color="#4a5869">Controls:</font> <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-06</b></font> Key rotation &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>AM-03</b></font> Admin access review &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; <font color="#2b5c8f"><b>CM-02</b></font> Restricted key and deploy access" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Inter;fontSize=11;fontColor=#17212e;spacing=0;spacingLeft=0;spacingRight=0;" vertex="1" parent="register"><mxGeometry x="670" y="190" width="620" height="56" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

How it could happen here: The authorization table is changed outside the approved process.
Controls: CM-02 Restricted write access · CM-09 Reviewed database changes · LA-01 Edits logged

AM-02 Privileged access, or the credentials and code that grant it, is misused or excessive
How it could happen here: IAM user keys in Parameter Store, or the Lambda code, are misused to assume any role.
Controls: AM-06 Key rotation · AM-03 Admin access review · CM-02 Restricted key and deploy access
